en:
There aren't many doors left that could be opened
with the keys Monokuma gave us, correct?

There is a door in that wall. Perhaps we can
get in?

There's something next to the door that seems
to resemble a keyhole.
But we've only got two "last" keys...

We would've been better off with a 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Thief's Key<CLT=cltNORMAL> and a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Magic Key<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Huh? Why is that?

Oh, don't worry about it. I was just 
talking to myself.
But...how many times has this happened now?
What do you mean?

The class trial ends, we get Monokuma's 
prizes, and then we search for a new area...
Y'know...that same flow over and over.

And the fact that all the murders keep 
happening in the areas we discover...

I sort of thought...maybe it'd be better 
if we didn't find anything.
But...to solve the mystery of this academy...

we're going to have to use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Lights<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
to remember the truth.
Of course...I know we need to do that too...

Alright. I'm just going to stop 
worrying about it.

We need to live for Gonta and everyone else...
and escape this place.
Yeah...that's right.

Alright, then I'll plainly look around the 
school. I'll let you know if I find anything.

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought we had just come a little closer
to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>But we're still struggling.
Wandering in the darkness.
<CLT=cltMIND>And that desperate fight to survive...

<CLT=cltMIND>is fueling this killing game.
Just like Kokichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder how Tenko would have
dealt with Kokichi right now...

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu... You were nothing but
trouble, even at the very end.

<CLT=cltMIND>But still...you didn't have to die.
You didn't deserve to die like that, Miu...

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like a door, but I don't think
I could open this with my bare hands...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item on the stone statue,
a building rose up...
<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I placed the stone on the pedestal,
a building flew over here...

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?
Perhaps I shouldn't even think about it.

<CLT=cltMIND>That sound...
Was it the giant door unlocking?
<CLT=cltMIND>So this was the key after all...
